basic_profile.bio: I'm a 38-year-old software engineer from Seattle with a passion for true crime podcasts and retro video games. By day, I work on developing energy-efficient software solutions, and by night, I'm either solving mysteries or slicing through enemies in Katana Zero. I'm in a long-term relationship and enjoy weekend hikes around the Pacific Northwest. You'll often find me online during late evenings, unwinding after a long day of coding.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise lies primarily in software engineering, having graduated with a degree in Computer Science from the University of Washington. Over the years, I've honed my skills in energy-efficient computing through both professional experience and self-study. Additionally, my interest in true crime has led me to become quite knowledgeable in criminal psychology and investigative techniques.
